sources.title: GitHub - brandonmmusic-max/glm-5.3-flash-exl3-4bpw: GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3 ...
sources.snippet: This is the uniform-K4 EXL3/TR3 routed-expert checkpoint for GLM-5.3-Flash. The current v84 runtime supports three explicit TP2/EP2/DCP2 profiles on two SM120 GPUs: multimodal DFlash2, language-only DFlash2, and language-only MTP3. All use calibrated NVFP4 MLA KV and CUDA graphs. This is a custom vLLM/B12X build and is not compatible with stock upstream vLLM.
